content:
zoe: We need a 45m SIEM snapshot for live vuln triage — contains auth events, token refresh logs, and service-account audit. Requesting KMS unwrap + ephemeral read role. Who can approve?

matt: can we scope to only affected tenant and remove email addresses? also need a ticket and justification. 

zoe: ticket SEC-9902 created, linked in thread. scope=tenant:acme-corp, ttl=2700s (45m). We need raw trace_id and svc_account_id for correlation. 

nina: recommend using scrubbing pipeline to mask emails and hostnames, keep ip and trace for triage. follow sec-data-access-policy v3. For incident exports use tag `incident-ephemeral` and set audit retention to 90d. 

alina: legal: confirm no customer-identifying content. if any PII remains, DPA needed. otherwise legal will OK timeboxed export. 

devops-bot: Action: run `/export_request --key projects/redwood/keys/siem --ttl 2700 --ticket SEC-9902 --scope=tenant:acme-corp` to create unwrap request. Approval required per policy: one security approver + oncall. 

sam: i'll review. @matt please run the scrub and post sample before unwrap. 

matt: scrub command:
```
./bin/scrub --source=siem://auth?tenant=acme-corp --remove=email,username --mask=hostname --keep=trace_id,ip --out=gs://incident-exports/SEC-9902
```
started scrub now. 

zoe: added incident owner tag and escalation notes in SEC-9902. need an auditor to watch the access. @jade can you join? 

jade: i'll shadow and capture audit entries. will not download or copy. 

oncall-bot: oncall: leo. leo please acknowledge and prepare to approve the unwrap. 

leo: Acked. i'll be available to approve once scrub sample is posted. 

matt: scrub done, sample uploaded to ticket. initiating unwrap request: `/export_request --key projects/redwood/keys/siem --ttl 2700 --ticket SEC-9902` => req-id sec-unwrap-1719994242. Sent to sam and leo for approval. 

devops-bot: KMS unwrap request sec-unwrap-1719994242 created. Awaiting approvals from sam and leo. All actions audited. 

sam: approved sec-unwrap-1719994242. noted in SEC-9902. 

leo: approved sec-unwrap-1719994242. 

matt: unwrap executed. granted role `siem_ephemeral_reader:expires=2024-06-18T14:12:22Z` to group [vuln-triage-acme]. Export path: `gs://incident-exports/SEC-9902/1719994242`. cleanup scheduled in 45m. 

nina: reminder: no copies to external drives or slack. read-only access; queries logged. Also disable any auto-forwarding rules on exported objects. 

alina: legal: confirmed no DPA required; comment added to SEC-9902. 

zoe: triage complete. root cause identified and mitigated. initiating cleanup. thanks all. 

jade: verified cleanup and attached audit screenshots to ticket. 

devops-bot: cleanup complete for `gs://incident-exports/SEC-9902/1719994242`. KMS request sec-unwrap-1719994242 archived. 

zoe: closing SEC-9902. will follow up with a 1-page runbook for future ephemeral exports. :metal:
